owner_posts.post_text: This is a contemporary live-edge wood dining table featuring a thick, solid hardwood slab tabletop that showcases organic contours and rich, swirling natural grain patterns, The rustic, warm-toned wooden top is contrasted by sleek, modern black metal U-shaped legs, blending industrial design with organic modernism, By Shahnawaz Khan from Haji Abdul Sattar And Sons Mumbai.
That is a beautiful, classic four-poster bed with a wonderful rustic charm, in Teak wood and the woven grid detailing rattan work on the headboard give it a very distinct, elegant personality.
That is a gorgeous piece of furniture, It looks like a classic Art Deco console table, likely from the 1930s or designed in that signature style, By Haji Abdul Sattar And Sons in Mumbai
That is a beautifully crafted Wooden Barrel, The raw, light-toned wood and the metal banding give it a very clean, rustic look that serves as a great canvas for custom modifications.
That is a beautiful piece of craftsmanship, Based on the design, it appears to be a Mid-Century Modern style Shoe Cabinet, likely made from Teakwood, given the rich grain and regional branding.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently bought a hand-knotted Kashmiri carpet and a Kashmiri pashmina shawl from Mumbai Art Bazaar, and I’m beyond impressed with both purchases. The carpet is absolutely stunning — the floral patterns and colors look even more beautiful in person. The silk threads give it a subtle shine that changes with the light, making it look rich and luxurious. When I turned it over, I could clearly see the fine knots, which truly shows the craftsmanship and authenticity. It instantly made my living room feel warmer and more elegant, and guests keep asking where I got it from!

featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are in Mumbai, a visit to Mumbai Art Bazaar is an absolute must.

This beautiful store offers the finest selection of authentic Kashmiri treasures, exquisite pashmina scarves, hand-embroidered shawls, stunning silk and wool rugs and so many unique handcrafted items that you could spend hours admiring every detail. The quality is truly exceptional, and you immediately feel the craftsmanship and tradition behind each piece.

They also carry outstanding saffron (the aroma alone tells you it’s the real thing!), delicious Shirazi specialties, and other carefully selected delicacies that are hard to find elsewhere.

featured_reviews.name: Soumya Peruri
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently purchased a few products from this brand. Here are my thoughts:

1. A6 khaki diary:
It is exactly as it is shown in the pictures. I particularly love this cassette design from their retro series. It is the perfect size for me to experiment and play around with during sketching sessions. I tested it with charcoal, gouache, and soft pastels, and these mediums worked great on the paper. Paper thickness is great for light paint washes. The best part is that the pages are infused with a subtle coffee aroma, which makes using this diary such a unique and enjoyable experience. While I haven’t used it for travel sketching yet, I’m excited to try out some travel sketches with pen and ink. The compact size makes it ideal for sketching on the go. Overall, if you want to experiment with a toned paper sketchbook, you should definitely give this a try.

2. A4 Khaki sheets (300gsm):
The paper has a little texture to it and holds up well to a variety of mediums. I tested it with charcoal, gouache, and soft pastels—gouache in particular, looked stunning. The colors came out bright and vibrant. The paper’s thickness makes it easy to build up multiple layers of paint without any issues. Acrylics could work well on this paper too, though I haven’t tried them yet. What didn’t work as well were colored pencils—both Prismacolor and Polychromos didn’t show up as brightly as I’d hoped, but for opaque painting mediums, this paper is a solid choice.

featured_reviews.name: Shuvankar Patra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience ordering from your website. This was my first time purchasing from you, and unfortunately, it has been very frustrating.

After placing the order, I called your team to request expedited delivery and agreed to pay on delivery on Thursday. I was informed that it would ship out on Friday to Kolkata. However, there were no updates until Tuesday. When I followed up, I was shocked to learn that Satguru had canceled my order without proper communication.

I placed this order because I have an international flight next week and needed to carry the item with me abroad. The delay and cancellation have put me in a very difficult situation.

Additionally, I was asked via WhatsApp to pay INR 2500 for delivery charges, even though your website clearly states free delivery. This inconsistency is unacceptable and feels misleading.

In contrast, I placed an order with The Bombay Store, and they delivered the very next day without charging any extra delivery fees. I have been their customer since 2015 and have always had a reliable experience. This situation clearly shows the difference in professionalism and customer service.

If I had been informed earlier about the issue, I would have ordered from another website and avoided this inconvenience. Because of this delay and cancellation, I am now unable to bring the Hindu deity with me as planned.

I sincerely hope you review your customer service, communication practices, and delivery policies so other customers do not face similar disappointment.

In conversation I told the lady I am going to share this matter in social media she said go head we do not care , it's ok.

Brand matters.

featured_reviews.name: Romit Mitra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've come here about seven or eight times over the last ten years for their framing services.

They are superb. Not only is their execution of the frames top notch, but what was really unexpected is the high quality of their advice while choosing framing and mounting options.

Major credit for all the art that hangs on our walls indeed go to their creators; however it's plainly acknowledged in our household that Satguru's plays a critical role for making them shine.

featured_reviews.name: Parag Sayta
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had got an antique map framed at Satguru’s Andheri last year. I paid a 3x premium over local framers on the basis that I will get premium quality and service. To my shock, fungus has seeped in through the frame and spoilt the map within a year. There is no particular dampness or moisture on the wall where the map was kept.

When I went to Satguru’s Andheri, they said they can’t do anything about it and I need to visit Satguru’s Khar. At Satguru’s Khar, they said there will be an INR 5,000/- extra charge to replace the wood at the back of the frame(!). I wasn’t expecting free service, but looking to charge so much a year after I purchased the frame and making me run around from Andheri to Khar has made this a bitter experience. On top of this, there was zero sympathy or service etiquette from the owner or staff- all they were looking to do was to argue that it wasn’t their fault and they bore no responsibility for this.

I will never buy anything from Satguru’s again and would encourage others to also look at alternative options which offer better service and value than Satguru’s.

featured_reviews.name: Taste and Travel
featured_reviews.review_text: They have a good collection and I have even purchased a few artefacts, showpieces and decorative gifts from here before. Having been a customer since the year the store first opened, I had a disrespectful experience on my last visit with my family when I was looking at the paintings and one staff member started profiling me with intrusive questions and decided to kick me and my family out. We will not be returning.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Taste & Travel, we apologise if you feel that our staff did not speak to you in the right way. If you can please elaborate the situation leading upto this we can investigate the matter further, we would like you to describe the staff who attended to you to understand their side of the incident as well. Be rest assured we will look into this seriously once we have more information from you. Regards, Team Satgurus
